The team note is wrong. Its two candidate formulas give 190 and 331 for n=10, not the required 271. The existing formula matches the assert and the standard centered hexagonal sequence (1, 7, 19, 37, ...).

```python
def centered_hexagonal_number(n):
    return 3 * n * (n - 1) + 1


assert centered_hexagonal_number(10) == 271
```
